U.note: Working flat top-down painter with 8 colors, undo, save PNG, but blank and plain, and the mobile canvas grid renders with uneven moire lines.

V.note: Polished flat 32x32 painter with counts, disabled states, two-step clear and good a11y, but only 4 kinds and starts empty with little sense of building.

W.note: Isometric 3D voxel world with stacking, terrain, pond and tree, picking, hotbar, undo, erase and persistence; clearly feels like a block-building sandbox and is responsive.

X.note: Top-down grid with stackable columns up to 6 and a fake-height look, clear controls and keyboard shortcuts, but only 3 block types and a dull empty start.

Y.note: Plain dark DOM grid with a side palette; works and autosaves but is visually bland, empty at rest, and the mobile palette pushes controls below the fold.

Z.note: Side-view Minecraft-like world with textured blocks, prefilled terrain and tree, 9 block types, undo/clear/reset and persistence; charming and works well though canvas runs slightly below fold on desktop.
